captions.detailed: This 3D model features a central black mounting base from which two distinct multi-segment arms extend in opposite directions. One arm is distinguished by an orange segment, while the other features a blue segment, each ending in a dark grey tip. Each arm functions as an independent kinematic chain, articulating via multiple revolute joints that allow rotational movement along their respective axes.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated branching mechanism with a central black base supporting two separate, opposing arms. One arm should feature an orange segment and the other a blue segment, each terminating in a dark grey end-effector and rotating independently via multiple revolute joints.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first building a static base assembly using a rectangular flange and a vertical support column. Two symmetric kinematic chains are then defined branching from this central base. Each chain is composed of three sequential links: a proximal joint connector, a colored middle segment (one orange, one blue) created from combined box and cylinder primitives, and a terminal dark grey end-effector. These links are connected in series using revolute joints with specified rotation axes.
